title: Test-file header still says anchor routing is E2E-only, but the file ends with anchor-routing unit tests
detail: Comment carried over from the r0 version (embedded diff.txt copy has no anchor tests with the same header); the post-review version unit-tests anchor resolution, so the header misdescribes the file's own coverage.
recommended_fix: Reword the header — drop "anchor routing" from the E2E-only list, or clarify that only the click-handler wiring (not resolveAnchorTarget) is E2E-covered.

title: Committed diff.txt is an unlabeled r0 snapshot that no longer matches the shipped code it appears to document
evidence: diff.txt:1097 shows the r0 bug: "+          var target = resolveFieldElement(doc, id);" while the shipped server/priv/static/form_stepper.js:514 reads "          var target = resolveAnchorTarget(doc, a.getAttribute(\"href\"));"; diff.txt line 1 begins "diff --git a/server/priv/static/form.css" with no sha or round marker.
detail: Committing the reviewed diff alongside the review reports is fine, but nothing labels it as the round-0 baseline; it still shows the anchor double-prefix bug, slice(0,200) test, and inlined summary string — all fixed in the shipped code — so a later reader can mistake it for the final PR diff.
recommended_fix: Add a one-line header (or sibling README) stating the reviewed sha and review round, e.g. "PR diff at review round r0, sha <hash> — superseded by the merged PR".
